title: `lxd_memory_MemAvailable_bytes` ignores `slab_reclaimable`, underreports by tens of GiB
description:
> _Writeup by Claude Code on behalf of the reporter. Findings, reproduction, and patch sketch verified against the repository._

### Please confirm

- [x] I have searched existing issues to check if an issue already exists for the bug I encountered.

### Distribution

Ubuntu

### Distribution version

24.04

### Output of `snap list --all lxd core20 core22 core24 core26 snapd`

```shell
lxd     5.21.4-aee7e08  38767  5.21/stable
core24  20260317        1587   latest/stable
snapd   2.75.2          26865  latest/stable
```

### System info

Kernel version: 6.17.0-14-generic
LXC version: 6.0.4
LXD version: 5.21.4 (also reproduces on `main`)
Storage backend: zfs / ceph

### Instance log

n/a

### Expected behavior

`lxd_memory_MemAvailable_bytes` should match `/proc/meminfo`'s `MemAvailable` — i.e. include reclaimable slab. `SReclaimable` (or `Slab`) should also be exposed as its own metric.

### Actual behavior

`lxd_memory_MemAvailable_bytes` ≈ `MemFree`; reclaimable slab is dropped entirely.

MariaDB container (128 GiB limit, 80 GiB InnoDB buffer pool, `O_DIRECT` so page cache stays tiny):

| field | `/proc/meminfo` (inside) | `lxd_memory_*` |
|---|---|---|
| MemTotal | 128.00 GiB | 128.00 GiB |
| MemFree | 14.16 GiB | 14.11 GiB |
| MemAvailable | **39.77 GiB** | **14.20 GiB** ← off by 25.6 GiB |
| Cached | 0.09 GiB | 0.09 GiB |
| SReclaimable | 25.53 GiB | *(not exposed)* |

Dashboards built on these metrics — including the upstream `dashboards/lxd.json` "Memory Usage (%)" panel — render such workloads at ~88% used when real pressure is ~68%, hiding genuine pressure behind constant false alarms.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run a workload generating dentry/inode pressure inside a container (MariaDB with binlog rotation, or `find / -xdev > /dev/null` in a loop).
2. Wait until `SReclaimable` in the container's `/proc/meminfo` grows substantially.
3. Compare `lxd_memory_MemAvailable_bytes` against `/proc/meminfo`'s `MemAvailable`. Divergence ≈ `SReclaimable`.

### Root cause

`lxd/cgroup/abstraction.go` `GetMemoryStats()` switches on `memory.stat` keys but has no case for `slab_reclaimable` — it's silently dropped before reaching the metrics layer. Downstream, `lxd/instance/drivers/driver_lxc.go:7309` computes:

```go
out.AddSamples(metrics.MemoryMemAvailableBytes,
    metrics.Sample{Value: float64(memoryLimit - memoryUsage + memoryCached)})
```

Adding back `Cached` only — `SReclaimable` is missing from the equation.

### Suggested fix

In `GetMemoryStats()`, parse `slab_reclaimable`. In `driver_lxc.go` (and parallels in `lxd-agent/metrics.go`, `driver_qemu_metrics.go`), expose it as a new `MemorySReclaimableBytes` metric and include it in the MemAvailable computation: `memoryLimit - memoryUsage + memoryCached + memorySReclaimable`.

Analogous to #18120, which reports the same conceptual error in `lxd/resources/memory.go` (the `lxc info --resources` endpoint).
